name: How long does hot water heater replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does hot water heater replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a hot water heater replacement depends on the type of unit and any necessary modifications. Replacing a conventional tank-style water heater with a similar model typically takes 2-4 hours. Upgrading to a tankless system or switching fuel types (e.g., electric to gas) can take longer, often 4-8 hours or more, as it may involve plumbing and venting adjustments. Our technicians work efficiently to restore your hot water as quickly as possible.
